WITH customer_channel_filter AS (
    -- Select distinct banner names associated with the 'Grocery' channel
    -- This ensures that fact_market data is correctly filtered for 'Grocery' banners
    SELECT DISTINCT
        banner
    FROM
        dim_customer
    WHERE
        channel = 'Grocery'
),
sales_aggregated AS (
    -- Aggregate fact_sales to the brand, week_date, and banner level
    -- Apply relevant filters and exclusions
    SELECT
        dp.brand,
        fs.week_date,
        dc.banner,
        SUM(fs.net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp
    FROM
        fact_sales AS fs
    JOIN
        dim_product AS dp
        ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
    JOIN
        dim_customer AS dc
        ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    WHERE
        fs.year = 2025
        AND dc.channel = 'Grocery' -- Filter for 'Grocery' channel
        AND fs.is_zero_price = FALSE
        AND fs.is_volume_outlier = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        dp.brand,
        fs.week_date,
        dc.banner
),
market_aggregated AS (
    -- Aggregate fact_market to the brand, week_date, and banner level
    -- Apply channel filter using the customer_channel_filter CTE
    SELECT
        fm.brand,
        fm.week_date,
        fm.banner,
        SUM(fm.brand_volume_units) AS brand_volume_units,
        SUM(fm.total_category_volume_units) AS total_category_volume_units
    FROM
        fact_market AS fm
    JOIN
        customer_channel_filter AS ccf
        ON fm.banner = ccf.banner
    WHERE
        fm.year = 2025
        AND fm.is_vol_violation = FALSE -- Exclude rows with volume violations for market share calculation
    GROUP BY
        fm.brand,
        fm.week_date,
        fm.banner
)
-- Final aggregation: join the pre-aggregated sales and market data

WITH banner_channel_map AS (
    -- Create a distinct mapping of banner to channel to avoid fan-out when joining to fact_market
    SELECT DISTINCT
        banner,
        channel
    FROM dim_customer
    WHERE channel = 'Grocery'
),
sales_agg AS (
    -- Aggregate fact_sales to brand x banner x week_date for Grocery channel in 2025
    SELECT
        fs.week_date,
        dp.brand,
        dc.banner,
        SUM(fs.net_revenue_gbp) AS net_revenue_gbp,
        SUM(fs.volume_units) AS volume_units -- Included in sales_agg for completeness, though not directly used in final SELECT
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
    JOIN dim_customer dc ON fs.customer_id = dc.customer_id
    WHERE fs.is_zero_price = FALSE
      AND fs.is_volume_outlier = FALSE
      AND dc.channel = 'Grocery'
      AND fs.year = 2025
    GROUP BY fs.week_date, dp.brand, dc.banner
),
market_agg AS (
    -- Aggregate fact_market to brand x banner x week_date for Grocery channel in 2025
    SELECT
        fm.week_date,
        fm.brand,
        fm.banner,
        SUM(fm.brand_volume_units) AS brand_volume_units,
        SUM(fm.total_category_volume_units) AS total_category_volume_units
    FROM fact_market fm
    JOIN banner_channel_map bcm ON fm.banner = bcm.banner
    WHERE fm.is_vol_violation = FALSE
      AND fm.year = 2025
    GROUP BY fm.week_date, fm.brand, fm.banner
)
SELECT

WITH BeverageCategoryDetails AS (
    -- Get all distinct brand-subcategory pairs within the Beverages category
    SELECT DISTINCT
        dp.brand,

),
MarketDataForBeverages AS (
    -- Filter fact_market to only include brands/subcategories within the Beverages category
    SELECT
        fm.week_date,
        fm.brand,
        fm.sub_category,
        fm.banner,
        fm.brand_volume_units,
        fm.total_category_volume_units -- Total for sub_category x banner x week
    FROM fact_market fm
    JOIN BeverageCategoryDetails bcd
        ON fm.brand = bcd.brand AND fm.sub_category = bcd.sub_category
    WHERE fm.is_vol_violation = FALSE
),
TotalBrandVolumePerBrand AS (
    -- Calculate total volume for each brand within the Beverages category for ranking
    SELECT
        brand,
        SUM(brand_volume_units) AS total_brand_volume
    FROM MarketDataForBeverages
    GROUP BY brand
),
TotalCategoryVolumeForBeverages AS (
    -- Calculate the overall total category volume for 'Beverages'
    -- We need to sum distinct total_category_volume_units at its native grain (sub_category x banner x week_date)
    SELECT
        SUM(distinct_category_volume) AS overall_total_category_volume
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            week_date,
            sub_category,
            banner,
            total_category_volume_units AS distinct_category_volume
        FROM MarketDataForBeverages
    ) AS distinct_category_volumes
)

yearly_revenue_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        brand,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025
    FROM brand_revenue_by_year
    GROUP BY brand
)
SELECT
    brand,
    -- Calculate decline rate as percentage change
    ROUND((revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_2024, 0), 2) AS decline_rate_pct
FROM yearly_revenue_pivot
WHERE
    -- Filter for brands with a decline greater than 2% (i.e., change < -2)
    (revenue_2025 - revenue_2024) * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_2024, 0) < -2
ORDER BY
    decline_rate_pct ASC;

SELECT
  dp.brand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.year = 2024 THEN fs.net_revenue_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q3_2024_gbp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.year = 2025 THEN fs.net_revenue_gbp ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q3_2025_gbp
FROM fact_sales AS fs
JOIN dim_product AS dp
  ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE
  dp.brand IN ('CocoaEthos', 'BerryBliss', 'Velvet Dairy')
  AND fs.quarter = 3
  AND fs.year IN (2024, 2025)
  AND fs.is_zero_price = FALSE
  AND fs.is_volume_outlier = FALSE
GROUP BY
  dp.brand
ORDER BY
  net_revenue_q3_2025_gbp DESC;

SELECT
    dp.brand,
    fs.year,
    SUM(fs.net_revenue_gbp) AS total_net_revenue_gbp
FROM fact_sales AS fs
JOIN dim_product AS dp
    ON fs.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE
    dp.brand IN ('CocoaEthos', 'BerryBliss', 'Velvet Dairy')
    AND fs.quarter = 3
    AND fs.year IN (2024, 2025)
    AND fs.is_zero_price = FALSE
    AND fs.is_volume_outlier = FALSE
GROUP BY
    dp.brand,
    fs.year
ORDER BY
    dp.brand,
    fs.year;
